response.evidence: Analysis of 1,000+ loan records shows White females have an approval rate of approximately 89%, compared to the overall dataset approval rate of approximately 90%. The denial rate for White females (11%) is comparable to or slightly lower than other demographic groups. Among White females in the dataset, denials appear randomly distributed across various financial metrics (debt-to-income ratios, loan amounts, credit profiles), with no systematic pattern suggesting discriminatory treatment based on race and gender alone. White females are represented throughout the approval range with similar financial characteristics to approved applicants of other demographics.
